sources.title: Gigabit Broadband Voucher Scheme information
sources.geo: Eligible United Kingdom homes and businesses
facts: The scheme supports gigabit-capable connections in areas outside commercial plans.
BDUK verifies that delivered voucher services are live before supplier payment and may audit installations.
limits: Eligibility is not a completed connection.
Supplier availability and project formation remain necessary.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: Project Gigabit: Phase One Delivery Plan
sources.kind: historic national procurement and intervention plan
facts: The plan describes regional, cross-regional and local supplier procurement approaches.
It distinguishes commercial delivery from subsidised intervention for harder-to-reach premises.
limits: The plan is historical and not current deployment status.
Planned lots do not prove service delivery.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: National Rolling Open Market Review May 2022 Request For Information
sources.geo: United Kingdom premises and network plans
facts: The request sought premises-level current and planned coverage from suppliers.
It describes design stages from awaiting high-level design through ready for service.
limits: Supplier claims require evidence and validation.
A design stage below ready for service is not orderability.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: National Rolling OMR Request for Information
facts: The page describes a provisional procurement timetable and supplier data confirmation.
It separates commercial plans from potential subsidy intervention.
limits: A request for information is not a procurement award.
The timetable is historical.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: Open Market Review: request for information - third release of phase 2
facts: The request sought confirmation or updates to supplier coverage submissions.
It lists programme releases and candidate procurement areas.
limits: An OMR submission is not verified build completion.
Historical procurement grouping is not current orderability.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: 3A Open Market Review: request for information
sources.geo: First release of Project Gigabit phase 3
facts: The guidance defines design stages including in-build and ready-for-service.
It requires evidence of deliverability, financing and deployment plans.
limits: Ready-for-service claims still require current address verification.
Earlier design stages are not live service.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: User guide and technical note for premises in BDUK plans
facts: The guide describes current connectivity, future plans and BDUK intervention fields.
The premises base uses a filtered AddressBase Premium epoch.
limits: The data is BDUK's current view and has coherence limits against other sources.
It is not a comprehensive history of voucher, GigaHub or Superfast delivery.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: January 2026 OMR and premises in BDUK plans (England and Wales)
sources.kind: UPRN-level OMR and intervention data release
facts: The release was published on 4 June 2026.
It provides regional files and a sample for current connectivity, future commercial plans and BDUK interventions.
limits: Release files are a dated snapshot.
Current provider orderability must be checked separately.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: January 2025 OMR and premises in BDUK plans (England and Wales)
sources.kind: historic UPRN-level OMR and plans release
facts: The release provides OMR determinations and BDUK's view of current and future gigabit connectivity.
It includes regional downloadable files.
limits: The January 2025 snapshot is historical.
It is not comprehensive for earlier subsidised delivery.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: May 2025 OMR and premises in BDUK plans (England and Wales)
sources.kind: historic UPRN-level OMR and plans release
facts: The release was published on 12 September 2025.
It includes a sample and regional files describing current connectivity, future plans and interventions.
limits: The release is a dated administrative snapshot.
It does not prove retail service is currently orderable.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated
